card.name: Worsening-of-disease phrases, mid-term
card.fires_on: The word 'of' after 'exacerbation' (or 'worsen' and similar) before a named disease. Also partway through disease terms like BPH, bullous or neurotoxicity after severity words.

modes.label: Exacerbation of
modes.description: The word 'of' right after exacerbation, before a disease or condition name.
modes.example: 5.1 Severe Acute Exacerbation<< of>> Hepatitis B

modes.label: Worsen
modes.description: The ending of 'worsen' in a warning about a condition getting worse.
modes.example: cause or wors<<en>> congestive heart failure or produce severe hyp

modes.label: Inside disease terms
modes.description: The start of a condition name after a severity or qualifier word, such as the B in BPH.
modes.example: Prior to initiating treatment with Finasteride Tablets, USP for<< B>>PH, consideration should be given to other

card.writes: It seems to steer the next word away from symptom words like pain, and toward a specific disease name.
card.plain: It fires when a label says a disease may flare up or worsen and a named condition comes next.
